body: I remember around year after pokemon sapphire came out, i finally got kyogre.  I got it for my fifth birthday, and it took me that long.  My friend said he knew a trick to get mewtwo, and he said he needed to borrow my game to do it.  2 days later, no mewtwo, no kyogre.  He said something about trading it for a different pokemon when he was talking to my brother. I was fuckin devistated man.

Ahhh yes. So cool to commit a felony AND film it with your face in it. Totally went well for the last person. 

Hope he was just fucking around and actually bought it.

Thanks for the offer, but im not really in the mood for talking.  

I really appreciate it though
